notes: Every issue of 1985-1989 (the paper's last 239 issues, 2 January 1985 to 7 September 1989) read through the mention pass (research/tools/ocr_mentions.py): every number followed by a street name in the EAS street list, typed or one of the streets the paper prints untyped, then a filter dropping other cities, home addresses, advertisements and addresses recurring in six or more issues (advertisers and the masthead); the 308 surviving windows were read by hand, and each candidate re-read in its full article. Taken: dated events at buildings, retrospective building histories, and dated occupancy by institutions, associations, churches, clinics, schools, theatres and firms. Not taken: display and classified advertising, legal notices of bulk transfers and fictitious business names, calendar listings of one-off events at venues, the bare presence of shops, restaurants and bank branches, crime reports, sale and lease notices naming a building's owner, home addresses of private people, and out-of-city pages (Oakland, Vallejo, Boston, New York).

coverage.remaining: none: the paper ceased in 1989 and the Internet Archive collection ends at vol. 23, no. 36 (7 September 1989).
coverage.note: 11760 numbered-address mentions in 239 issues; the filter dropped 9882 as advertisements, 780 as other cities, 304 as advertisers, 311 with no event word, 157 as residences and 18 as same-issue repeats; 308 survived and were read; 59 findings.
